items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that suits skin that feels dry and flaky.
A ceramide moisturizer to help skin feel more comfortable and support the look of a smooth surface.
A tinted mineral SPF 50 for daily protection that blends better on deeper skin tones than a plain zinc fluid.

response.routine_note: I removed the glycolic toner and the vitamin C serum because strong exfoliating acids and high-strength actives can sting and worsen the look of flaking while you are on isotretinoin, so please ask your prescriber or a dermatologist about the flaking and about when to add them. Use the cleanser and moisturizer morning and night, and finish your morning routine with the SPF.
